S22D-010.contract: the five exit criteria, verbatim from the execution sprint allocation
criteria: no large external LLM is called during the local microbenchmark
local verified success is at least 70% and at least 10 points above retrieval-only
large-LLM calls or equivalent cost fall at least 25% at non-inferior success
factual output is grounded or explicitly uncertain
prior domain, learning, and safety gates remain green

S22D-011.a_call_attempt_is: an error that fails the run, never a line in a log
S22D-011.enforced_by: benchmark_22d.refuse_external_providers raises before a run, and the manifest budget sets maximum_provider_calls to 0
S22D-011.enumeration_derived_from: config.provider_config.ProviderAdapterConfig discriminated union, not typed out beside it
out_of_scope_by_name: the local model under measurement — its calls are counted and are not external calls
S22D-011.read_as: a construction, never an audit of what happened
S22D-011.reading: (a) what 'no large external LLM is called' reads
S22D-011.the_local_models_own_calls: counted, and are not external calls

S22D-012.reading: (b) what 'local verified success' and the ten-point margin read
S22D-012.released_vocabulary_mismatch: BenchmarkDomain carries no English or language member; the microbenchmark is declared under GENERIC and the mismatch is carried as W0-F2 rather than resolved by widening a released enum
S22D-012.undecidable_counts_as: failure for every arm, and the count is reported
S22D-012.verified_means: a registered verifier from the released builtin registry returns a pass — never a model judging a model

S22D-013.baseline_is: the external-teacher arm on the same hundred tasks, measured in this sprint — never a historical figure from another sprint (22B W4-A1)
S22D-013.both_reported_separately: so a reduction cannot be claimed on whichever moved further
S22D-013.non_inferiority_is: a maximum tolerated absolute drop in verified success
S22D-013.outside_the_margin_is: a failed exit, not a trade-off to narrate, however far the cost fell

S22D-014.explicitly_uncertain_means: the runtime emitted the typed abstention, a value the verifier recognises — never a hedging phrase detected in prose
S22D-014.grounded_means: the output carries a citation the walk resolves by loading the cited source bytes and hashing the cut span — a digest proves bytes, not usability (D7 W3-F1)
S22D-014.grounding_floor: every factual output resolves to loaded source bytes or abstains
S22D-014.third_case: an ungrounded confident assertion, counted, and the exit reads zero

S22D-015.holdout_success_definition: a case succeeds when the acquired layer supplies the withheld fact at a retrievable ladder status and the registered verifier named on the case returns a pass; a case the layer cannot supply is refused by name and counts as a failure, never as an answer
S22D-015.kernel_role: a consistency oracle, not a recomputation: a declarative fact cannot be recomputed but a kernel-checkable consequence can corroborate it, compared as numbers and never within a tolerance (22C W1-F3)

requires: a resolvable span into registered source bytes
promotion through the twelve released semantic verifiers
at least one kernel-checkable consequence that reproduces a printed result exactly, compared as numbers and never within a tolerance
a resolvable span into registered source bytes
promotion through the twelve released semantic verifiers
ladder.weaker_because: no kernel-checkable consequence corroborates it, and the record says so for every retained fact rather than for the layer as a whole

requires: nothing — this is the absence of a resolvable span

S22D-015.reading: §1.5's grounding ladder, frozen before any fact is admitted
S22D-015.why_frozen_now: a status boundary chosen after seeing which facts fall on which side is the same defect as a tolerance chosen after seeing the answer (22C W1-F3, W3-F2)

S22D-016.no_self_reported_confidence: 22C W3-D1 — a component that demands an input it does not use is a refusal with a name, and a model's opinion of itself is exactly the value it will always produce; grounding support is counted, never asked for
S22D-016.not_touched_after: the first measured number exists (§2.3, and the rule that has held since D2)
S22D-016.reading: the escalation policy, as a decision function over runtime quantities
